title: Harvey
summary: Legal AI platform built for law firms and in-house counsel on top of frontier models.
bodyHtml:
Harvey builds a legal research and drafting platform that combines foundation models with firm-specific knowledge, precedent and workflow controls.

It is used by large law firms and corporate legal teams for contract review, due diligence and research, with a strong emphasis on citations and auditability.

Why it matters

  • Contract and diligence workflows
  • Firm knowledge retrieval
  • Citation and review controls

businessMeaning: Professional services are the clearest early market for AI because output is text and the billable hour is visible. The risk is that the model vendor captures the layer.
